headline: Purdue Northwest go top of the conference table
dek: A home win over Wisconsin-Parkside lifted Purdue Northwest above Northern Michigan and Roosevelt, who both have a match in hand. Roosevelt remain the only side in the conference without a defeat, six wins and five draws into the season.
displaced_by: Purdue Northwest beat Wisconsin-Parkside and lead the conference table on points

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring is top-heavy: Northern Michigan alone have scored more than Purdue Northwest and St. Cloud State together.

wire.line: Every side in the conference has now drawn at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Luca Rosen has scored eleven goals from 38 shots for Northern Michigan.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Matty Telfer has scored seven of Saginaw Valley State's seventeen goals, from 25 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cedrik Strupler has conceded two goals all season for Roosevelt and kept five shutouts.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mateusz Pass has made 40 saves for Wisconsin-Parkside while conceding thirteen goals.

last_match.line: Purdue Northwest's highest-scoring match of the season; Wisconsin-Parkside arrived off a goalless draw with Saginaw Valley State.

next_match.line: The new leaders visit the side they displaced; Northern Michigan are unbeaten in conference play and field the conference's leading scorer in Luca Rosen.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
